description: This file defines the MobileInput class, a platform-specific implementation of input handling for mobile devices within the Unity game engine. It manages virtual buttons and axes, providing methods to set and get input states and mouse position.

classes.name: MobileInput
classes.description: A class that handles mobile input by managing virtual buttons and axes, extending VirtualInput.

methods.name: AddButton
methods.description: Registers a new virtual button with the given name.

methods.name: AddAxes
methods.description: Registers a new virtual axis with the given name.

methods.name: GetAxis
methods.description: Returns the value of the specified axis, adding it if it does not exist.

methods.name: SetButtonDown
methods.description: Marks the specified button as pressed.

methods.name: SetButtonUp
methods.description: Marks the specified button as released.

methods.name: SetAxisPositive
methods.description: Sets the specified axis to positive (1).

methods.name: SetAxisNegative
methods.description: Sets the specified axis to negative (-1).

methods.name: SetAxisZero
methods.description: Resets the specified axis to zero.

methods.name: SetAxis
methods.description: Sets the specified axis to a given float value.

methods.name: GetButtonDown
methods.description: Checks if the specified button was pressed down.

methods.name: GetButtonUp
methods.description: Checks if the specified button was released.

methods.name: GetButton
methods.description: Checks if the specified button is currently pressed.

methods.name: MousePosition
methods.description: Returns the current virtual mouse position.
